about: The tables pull_vehicles.js pulls, whole, every column. {LANG} is the WIS language number (AR_LANG, 2 = English), {LANG2} the same zero-padded ('02', as ASRA writes it). Read by pull_vehicles.js and by ledger.py: a table is pulled again only when its query here changes, so a new table pulls just that one.

tables.name: W_Dokumente
tables.why: Reference tables beyond "which car is this" (2026-10-10): W_Dokumente        DokNrID -> docnr ("ah0320n100002a"): turns the cross-references printed on pages into links SACode, SANummer   option (SA) code and SA number descriptions AW_AssystFuellmengen, AW_AssystFussnote   engine oil capacities SSTeilID, SSTeilBenennung   damage-code component names: what the &H& hotspots on the 99xxxxxx picture menus name ASRA_*             labour operations and flat-rate times

tables.name: SSTeilBenennung
tables.where: TeilID IN (SELECT TeilID FROM SSTeilID WHERE SprachCode = {LANG})

tables.name: ASRA_Formel
tables.why: the flat-rate formulas per region and repair group: the stored time is a raw value, the flat rate is the formula applied to it (parse_links.py)

tables.name: ASRAW_UmfassttextID
tables.why: what a labour time includes and leaves out, and the notes on an operation or a whole group (2026-11-05): the scope text is a UTF-8 blob, one item a line ("Remove/install wheel(s)", "Does not include: ..."), shared between operations by UmfassttextID

tables.name: ASRAW_ID2Umfassttext
tables.where: UmfassttextID IN (SELECT UmfassttextID FROM ASRAW_UmfassttextID WHERE SprachAbk = '{LANG2}')

tables.name: W_SprachDokumente
tables.why: a document's date and what it replaces ("19.11.02 - Replaces SI 54/59"), for the Service Information / Service measure pages (2026-11-05, G3)

tables.name: Dok2AendText
tables.where: DokID IN (SELECT DokID FROM W_SprachDokumente WHERE SprachCode = {LANG})

tables.name: W_AssystTyp2Serviceintervall
tables.why: the service schedule (ASSYST, 2026-11-05, G1): a series' service interval, the first service by engine and oil sheet, and the jobs due by time or distance (each a maintenance sheet "ap..."); all small (< 1,000 rows)

tables.name: Gruppen
tables.why: function group and subgroup names per vehicle type ("42.10" = "Service brake"): the Manual tab's section names (parse_links.py wis_group)
